summary: The forgotten-added-voter experiment executed and all four comparisons scored as predicted (receipt b1daa1f4c9444b8d857bc7e0ab761691): after a committed AddVoter D and a restart with RestoreCommittedLogs the leader reports three servers without D while the others report four (violated, witness 1), and with C and D partitioned one Apply succeeds, committing and applying the entry at index 8 with C at 7 and D at 6 — only two of the four committed voters hold it although the committed configuration requires three (violated, witness 3); the controls keep four voters (index 5) and refuse the identical write under the committed membership (index 7, 'leadership lost while committing log'). The new child investigation is recorded as violated/asserted with that receipt as its evidence, the parent's pending-limitation replaced with the established consequence, and one repeat of the experiment requested since the outcome depends on the restarted leader winning its re-election and on the partition leaving exactly two voters connected.
